accounts.title: Chart of Accounts

mapping.hint: Place the accounts of your own chart on the rows of B01 / B02. A prefix counts every account whose number starts with it. The standard layout's own placement cannot be changed here.

loans.dayCountHint: Actual/365 and actual/360 count the interest of each day on the outstanding principal and need an interest rate; the interest paid then defaults to the interest of the days to the repayment.
loans.autoAccrueOn: Automatic month-end accrual: on (Fiscal periods → closing policy)
loans.autoAccrueOff: Automatic month-end accrual: off (switch it on in Fiscal periods → closing policy)
loans.postDrawdown: Post the drawdown to the books (Dr Bank / Cr Loan payable); repayments are then posted with their interest. Untick for a loan already booked by hand.
loans.title: Loans
loans.hint: Borrowings with their repayment schedule. The balance sheet shows the part due after 12 months as long-term. Drawing and repaying the money is still booked as a journal entry; the ledger here gives B01 the real due dates.
loans.schedule: Repayment schedule (principal due on each date)
loans.failed: The loan could not be saved.

offBalance.title: Off-balance Register
offBalance.hint: Accounts 001 – 008 (leased assets, goods held for others, foreign currency …) have no double entry: record each movement here. They are not part of the balance sheet.
offBalance.failed: The off-balance entry could not be saved.

fiscalPeriods.title: Fiscal Periods
fiscalPeriods.closeConfirm: Close period "{{periodName}}"? The period-end transfer (revenue and expenses to the result account) is posted and the period is locked. It can be reopened later.
fiscalPeriods.reopenHint: Reopen "{{periodName}}"? Its closing entry is voided and posting is allowed again; close the period once the corrections are made.
fiscalPeriods.policyYearEnd: Year end (one closing entry a year)
fiscalPeriods.policyMonthlyHint: Closing a period writes its own closing entry (revenue and expenses to the result account).
fiscalPeriods.autoAccrue: Accrue loan interest automatically at month end
fiscalPeriods.autoAccrueHint: From the 1st of each month the interest of the posted loans is accrued to the last day of the previous month (Dr interest expense / Cr interest payable); a closed period is skipped.
fiscalPeriods.policyYearEndHint: Closing a period only locks it; the last period of the fiscal year writes one closing entry for everything not yet closed. Change the mode only between fiscal years.
